decisions.reason: Selecting the default Mailreach package without spam-test credits does not change the registered campaign domain or registrar.
The Mailreach package choice does not change the domain's web-forwarding destination or behavior.
Excluding Mailreach spam-test credits does not alter the mailbox requirement or its required Gmail compatibility.
The Mailreach purchase selection is independent of the Zapier subscription plan and integration configuration.
The warm-up service package and spam-test-credit choice does not modify the deferred MeetAlfred email campaign's channel, automation mode, or platform.
The Mailreach package selection has no effect on the automated LinkedIn campaign.
The domain warm-up package choice does not change the deferred HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred synchronization method.
Mailreach spam-test credits are unrelated to the MeetAlfred configuration and Pro subscription plan.
The Mailreach package selection does not alter the silent-lead follow-up workflow or its cleanup constraint.
Spam-test credits in Mailreach are distinct from the restrictions on using production MeetAlfred leads and identities for integration testing.
The domain warm-up package choice does not change the requirement to preserve existing MeetAlfred integrations and campaigns.
Excluding Mailreach spam-test credits does not affect the visibility of email or LinkedIn communication history in HubSpot.
